notes.title: 10 days to release!
notes.notes: Working to improve the UX per feedback, and fixing bugs as they are found!

notes.title: Tutorial update!
notes.notes: A lot of small updates and fixes, but the biggest change for this update is the tutorial now includes a couple steps to ensure players understand the core controls.

notes.title: Skybox Texture Update
notes.notes: This update adds a nice skybox to gameplay, improving the look and feel of the game quite a bit.  The Main menu background has also been updated to match latest art style changes.

notes.title: Small Graphics Update!
notes.notes:
Graphics Update!
New animations added for:
* Projectile Impacts
* Mob Regeneration
* Mob Damage Resistance

A bug was found and fixed for large belt lines.
+Misc fixes around steam achievements.

notes.title: Hotfix corner belts
notes.notes:
Thanks for reporting the bugs!
This fixes a corner belt failure caused by a previous change.

notes.title: A few bug fixes, and some belt cleanup
notes.notes:
This fixes a bug with factories that are building things can can have more things on them (like belts and routers).  There was a bug where belts feeding into the factory would occasionally try to put items on the object being constructed instead of the factory itself.

This release also cleans up how belts and routers interface with buildings.  There should be a lot less mess with feeding items into factories.   Less getting items on the wrong belts and things.

Lastly, a factory that has not had its recipe set yet won't reject incoming items.  So you can set up your belts before setting up your recipes if you wish with less mess.

Like always, let us know on discord if you find any bugs with this release!
And thanks!

notes.title: Hotfix for belt stagger
notes.notes: A belt stagger got introduced by a last-minute change that made it past testing.  Should now be fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix for routers after performance update.
notes.notes: Performance update broke the router output.  This should fix it.

notes.title: Last big update for playtest?
notes.notes:
This is the biggest and likely the last big update for the playtest!

There are now 6 tiers of technology and resources, many UI improvements like right-clicking to cancel individual queued items, and displays on buildings to let you know what recipe has been assigned.

Huge thanks to everyone who participated in this playtest and sent me their feedback.  This update brings the factory side of the game very close to our final intentions for early access.  The next step will be to iterate and improve on the tower defense aspect of the game as well as adding polishes like Steam Achievements, ambient sounds, and special effects.

Please continue to play this update for the next week or so and provide your feedback.  Looking forward to getting the full game out to everyone soon!
